description: Bulk mutate various attributes on issues within an organization. Use when you need to update status, priority, assignment, or other attributes for multiple issues at once. Maximum of 1000 issues can be mutated, with a 100 issue limit per request.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for bulk mutating issues in a Sentry organization.

assignedTo.description: User or team to assign the issue to. Formats: <user_id>, user:<user_id>, <username>, <email>, team:<team_id>.
assignedTo.title: Assigned To

environment.description: Environment names to filter issues by. Used to narrow down which issues to mutate.
environment.title: Environment

id.description: Issue IDs to mutate. For non-status updates, this parameter is required. For status updates, it can be omitted to update all matching issues.
id.title: Id

inbox.description: Mark issue as reviewed in inbox.
inbox.title: Inbox

isPublic.description: Make the issue public or private.
isPublic.title: Is Public

isSubscribed.description: Subscribe or unsubscribe from issue notifications.
isSubscribed.title: Is Subscribed

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to affect. Default: 100, Maximum: 100.
limit.title: Limit

merge.description: Merge issues together. Requires multiple issue IDs.
merge.title: Merge

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization containing the issues to mutate.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project.description: Project IDs to filter issues by. Use -1 to include all available projects.
project.title: Project

query.description: Search query for filtering issues. Defaults to 'is:unresolved' if not specified. Only used when issue IDs are not provided.
query.title: Query

sort.description: Sort order for issues. Defaults to 'date'.
sort.title: Sort

statusDetails.description: Status details schema for issue resolution.

ignoreCount.description: Number of occurrences to ignore before escalating.
ignoreCount.title: Ignore Count

ignoreDuration.description: Duration in minutes to ignore the issue.
ignoreDuration.title: Ignore Duration

ignoreUserCount.description: Number of unique users to ignore before escalating.
ignoreUserCount.title: Ignore User Count

ignoreUserWindow.description: Time window in minutes for ignoreUserCount. Maximum value: 10080.
ignoreUserWindow.title: Ignore User Window

ignoreWindow.description: Time window in minutes for ignoreCount. Maximum value: 10080.
ignoreWindow.title: Ignore Window

inCommit.description: Commit information containing commit hash and repository details.
inCommit.title: In Commit

inNextRelease.description: Whether the issue is resolved in the next release.
inNextRelease.title: In Next Release

inRelease.description: The release version in which the issue is resolved.
inRelease.title: In Release

statusDetails.title: StatusDetails

viewId.description: View ID to apply view's query and filters. Only used when issue IDs are not provided.
viewId.title: View Id
